workflow: Choose a brush and click grid cells
Select a gimmick to edit its settings
Open Bounce Bootstrap, enter Play mode, then Save and Play
safety: External file changes are never silently overwritten
Furnace footprint and panel sweep are included in overlap checks
editor.play_note: Save and Play sets local sandbox progress and grants 10 of each booster, as in RND Workbench.

rules.durability: No numerical durability labels; remaining pieces, exposed core, weak-face marking and switch illumination communicate state.

tube.col_row: First pipe cell; furnace is one cell left, or one row above when vertical.
tube.length: Number of pipe cells, excluding furnace.
tube.hit: Pipe or furnace hit consumes one cell; pipe feeds toward the hot furnace.
tube.complete: Furnace cools and its collider disables.
tube.booster: One cell per objective per direct area hit.

cupboard.footprint: 3 columns by 2 rows, anchored at upper left.
cupboard.hit: Orthogonally adjacent ordinary block hits remove one plate. Direct booster hits also remove one plate.
cupboard.validation: At least 10 distinct adjacent ordinary blocks.

panel.width: World units; one cell is one unit.
panel.travel: Distance from centre to each endpoint.
panel.speed: Radians per second; editor displays period in seconds.
panel.preview: Aim line ends at moving panel because later reflection depends on timing.

mine.hit: Explodes once; hits all eight neighbouring cells and chains other mines. Each explosion hits a multi-cell gimmick once.

switch_gate.link: Matching string link IDs connect switches and gates. Both require a matching counterpart.
switch_gate.hit: Switch permanently opens all linked gates; both are excluded from clear objectives.

combo.hit: The same living ball must hit twice; each ball tracks its own first hit. Draining removes that ball progress.
combo.visual: First hit exposes cyan core; shell closes when no armed balls remain.
combo.power: Direct power or mine blast clears it.

armor.hit: Only an incoming physical hit on the configured weak face clears it.
armor.power: Direct power or mine blast clears it.

edit_mode.environment: isolated worktree with final task sources

play_mode.environment: isolated worktree with final task sources and generated prefab assets

validation.visual_review: Combined prefab board and open gate captures inspected; mechanics verified by tests. Demo difficulty has not been comprehensively play-balanced.

prefabs.authoring: All visuals instantiate saved prefabs. Edit prefabs directly; Create Missing Prefabs preserves existing prefab files.
